quote: Holders of GE common stock received one share of GE HealthCare common stock for every three shares of GE common stock held. The distribution was part of a tax-free spin-off, resulting in tax efficiency for GE shareholders in the United States. GE is retaining approximately 19.9 percent of the shares of GE HealthCare common stock. Culp will serve as non-executive chairman of GE HealthCare. Paul, Weiss, Rifkind, W
note: 只确认2023 GE HealthCare分配比例；2024及IBM仍待核验
